description: A PROFILING probe, not a modelling run: f30_profile_probe_25pct with RUN.machine.event_handler_threads = 2 and NOTHING else changed, so the pair isolates one knob. It exists because the 9.154 flight recording decomposed the events pipeline for the first time and found the QUEUEING, not the handling, at the top of it: 11.6% of all CPU samples are one LinkedBlockingQueue.offer -> signalNotEmpty -> AbstractQueuedSynchronizer.release inside SimStepParallelEventsManagerImpl$ProcessEventsRunnable, plus 2.9% in ConditionObject.await. That manager is a CHAIN, not a fan-out - each runnable holds an eventsQueue and a nextEventsQueue and forwards to the next - so an event pays N lock-protected hops for N threads, and at 9.59's measured ~134.5M events an iteration, 96.4% of them link enter/leave, four threads cost ~538M queue operations where two would cost ~269M. The knob's own two measured points do not bracket this: 1 thread was measured SATURATED (172-177 s CPU against a ~265 s iteration, throttling the qsim at every sim-step sync) and 12 bought NOTHING over 4 (9.56, 9.59). 2 has never been run, and it is the only value that halves the hops without putting every handler back on one thread. The knob is RUN IDENTITY-FREE and verified so: event handlers are observers, each still receives the complete stream in per-handler order, and mode stats, score stats and the event multiset are bit-identical across values (9.56). This overlay therefore opens NO family and nothing produced under it is a reading of any mode. Iterations 1-3 are the comparison window against 20260907T192715_4it_25pct (0 pays JIT warm-up); both sides carry the recorder's ~8%, so the comparison is like-for-like.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7), so the whole range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This overlay is not one: it prices one wall-time knob against a baseline taken on the same overlay four hours earlier, and four iterations are the window that measurement needs (0 warms up, 1-3 compare). The value is deliberately far below the range so that any output carrying it is obviously not a result. Same reasoning as f30_profile_probe_25pct (9.154) and f27_timing_probe_25pct (9.147).
